facts.name: Return of Premiums – No Interest

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit – Phase 1

facts.name: Phase 2 Coverage Period
facts.sentence: Phase 2 of the policy covers Years 3 to 5.

facts.name: Phase 2 Death Benefit
facts.sentence: During Phase 2, all types of death result in a benefit of $7,500.

facts.name: Phase 3 Start Timing
facts.sentence: Phase 3 of the policy begins on the sixth policy anniversary.

facts.name: Phase 3 Start Date

facts.name: Annual Benefit Increase Start
facts.sentence: Starting from the sixth policy anniversary, the face amount increases by $150 annually on each policy anniversary.

facts.name: Annual Increase Until $10K Cap
facts.sentence: The annual increase in the face amount continues until a maximum of $10,000 is reached.

facts.name: Maximum Face Amount Cap

facts.name: Face Amount Cap Guarantee
facts.sentence: Once the face amount reaches $10,000, it remains level at that amount indefinitely.

facts.name: Fixed Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The monthly premium remains fixed at $79.00 throughout the life of the policy.

facts.name: Phase 3 Start Date
facts.sentence: Phase 3 begins on November 1, 2026.

facts.name: Guaranteed Benefit Activation

facts.name: Dividend-Independent Benefit
facts.sentence: The increasing benefit is not dependent on dividends.

facts.name: Contractual Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: The increasing benefit is not subject to the Company's discretion.

facts.name: Contractual Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: The increasing benefit is a contractual guarantee.

facts.name: Year 1 Non-Accidental Death Payout
facts.sentence: For Year 1, which spans before November 1, 2025, if the Insured dies from non-accidental causes, the Company pays a return of all premiums paid to date without interest.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout: Year 1
facts.sentence: For Year 1, which spans before November 1, 2025, if the Insured dies from accidental causes, the Company pays $7,500.

facts.name: Year 2 Non-Accidental Death Payout
facts.sentence: For Year 2, which spans from November 1, 2025, to October 31, 2026, if the Insured dies from non-accidental causes, the Company pays a return of all premiums paid to date without interest.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout: Year 2
facts.sentence: For Year 2, which spans from November 1, 2025, to October 31, 2026, if the Insured dies from accidental causes, the Company pays $7,500.

facts.name: Year 3 Start Date
facts.sentence: Year 3 begins on November 1, 2026.

facts.name: Year 3 Benefit Activation
facts.sentence: Starting in Year 3, the full benefit begins.

facts.name: Accidental Death Definition
facts.sentence: Accidental death is defined as death resulting from a sudden, violent, external event unrelated to illness.

facts.name: Accident Death Time Limit
facts.sentence: Accidental death must occur within 90 days of the accident.

facts.name: Accident Report Requirement
facts.sentence: The Company may require an official accident report for accidental death claims.

facts.name: Police Report Requirement
facts.sentence: The Company may require a police report for accidental death claims.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: Suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date results in a benefit limit of return of premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: Suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date applies regardless of mental state at the time of death.

facts.name: Suicide Coverage Post-24 Months
facts.sentence: After 24 months from the Policy Date, suicide is covered under the policy.

facts.name: Intoxication Exclusion (Years 1–2)
facts.sentence: If death is caused by voluntary intoxication with blood alcohol concentration ≥ 0.10%, the benefit during Years 1–2 is limited to return of premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Intoxication Limit on Benefits
facts.sentence: Voluntary intoxication during Years 1–2 contributes to limiting the benefit to return of premiums paid without interest.

facts.name: Intoxication Coverage Expansion
facts.sentence: During Year 3 and beyond, intoxication alone does not reduce the benefit.

facts.name: Intoxication Causation Rule
facts.sentence: Intoxication reduces the benefit only when it is the direct cause of death.

facts.name: Intoxication Benefit Limit (Years 1–2)
facts.sentence: The benefit limitation for intoxication alone during Years 1–2 is restricted to return of premiums.

facts.name: Intoxication Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: During Year 3+, intoxication alone does not reduce the benefit unless it is the direct cause of death.

facts.name: Felony Exclusion – Years 1–2
facts.sentence: If the insured dies while committing or attempting to commit a felony, the benefit during Years 1–2 is limited to return of premiums.

facts.name: Felony Exclusion Expires in Year 3+
facts.sentence: For deaths occurring in Year 3+ due to felony involvement, the felony exclusion expires and the full benefit applies.

facts.name: War Exclusion Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: If the insured’s death results from an act of declared or undeclared war, armed conflict, insurrection, or civil war, the benefit is limited to return of premiums paid.

facts.name: War Exclusion Active Participant Rule
facts.sentence: The war exclusion applies when the insured is an active participant in such conflicts, including as a combatant.

facts.name: War Exclusion Scope

facts.name: Contract Scope Definition
facts.sentence: The Contract consists of the policy, the application, any riders, and any amendments.

facts.name: Application Incorporation
facts.sentence: The application is incorporated by reference into the Contract.

facts.name: Company Designation
facts.sentence: Heartland Legacy Life Insurance Company is referred to as 'the Company' in the Contract.

facts.name: Agent Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: No agent may alter the Contract.

facts.name: Agent Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: No agent may waive any provision of the Contract.

facts.name: Simplified Issue Policy Type
facts.sentence: This policy is a Simplified Issue policy.

facts.name: Health Attestation Requirement
facts.sentence: Issuance of this policy was contingent upon the Owner providing affirmative answers to the health attestation questions in the application.

facts.name: Health Misrepresentation Risk
facts.sentence: Misrepresentation of health status may result in the policy being voided during the contestability period.

facts.name: Three-Tier Death Benefit
facts.sentence: A three-tier schedule governs the Death Benefit Structure of this policy.

facts.name: Tier 1 Coverage Period
facts.sentence: Tier 1 applies to Policy Months 1 through 12.

facts.name: Tier 1 Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 1 equals 50% of the Face Amount.

facts.name: Face Amount Determination
facts.sentence: The Face Amount is $15,000.

facts.name: Tier 1 Premium Return
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 1 includes the total premiums paid, which are returned to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Tier 2 Death Benefit Period
facts.sentence: Tier 2 applies to Policy Months 13 through 24.

facts.name: Tier 2 Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 2 equals 75% of the Face Amount.

facts.name: Tier 2 Premium Return
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 2 includes the total premiums paid, which are returned to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Tier 3 Effective Period
facts.sentence: Tier 3 applies to Policy Month 25 and thereafter.

facts.name: Tier 3 Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 3 equals 100% of the Face Amount.

facts.name: Tier 3 Death Benefit Terms
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Tier 3 does not include any additional premium return.

facts.name: Tier 3 Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Under Tier 3, the full face amount of $15,000 is paid to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Accidental Death Override
facts.sentence: An Accidental Death Override exists in the policy.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Override
facts.sentence: If the Insured’s death results directly and independently of all other causes from an accidental bodily injury, the Tier 3 benefit is payable.

facts.name: Definition of Accidental Bodily Injury
facts.sentence: The definition of accidental bodily injury is provided in Section 9 of the policy.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The Accidental Death Override allows the Tier 3 benefit of $15,000 to be payable from the Policy Date.

facts.name: Accidental Death Override Clause
facts.sentence: The Accidental Death Override applies regardless of which Tier would otherwise apply based on timing.

facts.name: Accidental Death Timing Rule
facts.sentence: For the Accidental Death Override to apply, the accident must cause death within 180 days of the injury.

facts.name: $10,000 Death Benefit Payable
facts.sentence: A sum of $10,000 is payable from the Policy Date.

facts.name: Unconditional Payout Clause
facts.sentence: The $10,000 payout is payable regardless of which Tier would otherwise apply.

facts.name: Death Within 180 Days
facts.sentence: Accidental death must occur within 180 days of the injury.

facts.name: Return of Premium Rider Form
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium Rider form number is HL-ROP-7-2022.

facts.name: Return of Premium if Survives 7th Anniversary
facts.sentence: If the Insured survives to the 7th Policy Anniversary, the Company will pay the Owner a one-time Return of Premium Benefit.

facts.name: 7th Anniversary Trigger
facts.sentence: The 7th Policy Anniversary occurs on March 15, 2031.

facts.name: Return of Premium Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium Benefit equals 50% of all base policy premiums paid up to the 7th Policy Anniversary.

facts.name: Return of Premium Does Not Reduce Face Value
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium Benefit does not reduce the Face Amount.

facts.name: Return of Premium No Cash Value Impact
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium Benefit does not reduce the cash value.

facts.name: One-Time Return Benefit
facts.sentence: The Return of Premium Benefit is paid only once.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Invalidates ROP
facts.sentence: No Return of Premium Benefit is paid if the policy lapses before the 7th Policy Anniversary.

facts.name: Rider Premium Inclusion
facts.sentence: The monthly rider premium is included in the $143.20 modal premium.

facts.name: Rider Cost: $9.40/Month
facts.sentence: The rider cost is $9.40 per month.

facts.name: Guaranteed Level Premium
facts.sentence: The monthly premium of $143.20 is guaranteed to remain level for the life of the policy.

facts.name: Guaranteed Level Premium
facts.sentence: The monthly premium of $143.20 will never increase.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are due on the 15th of each month.

facts.name: Premium Payment Method
facts.sentence: Premiums are paid via Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT).

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies to each premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage remains in force during the grace period.

facts.name: Annual Payment Discount
facts.sentence: A 3% discount applies if the Owner elects annual payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium with Discount
facts.sentence: The annual premium amount with the mode discount is $1,666.56.

facts.name: Mode Change Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: Mode changes require 30 days' written notice.

facts.name: Annual Payment Discount
facts.sentence: If the Owner elects annual payment, a 3% discount applies.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium amount is $1,666.56 when the Owner elects annual payment.

facts.name: Payment Mode Change Notice
facts.sentence: Mode changes require 30 days of written notice.

facts.sentence: If the Insured becomes totally and permanently disabled before age 80, premiums will be waived.

facts.name: Disability Definition Reference
facts.sentence: Total and permanent disability is defined in Section 9.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Duration
facts.sentence: Premium waiver due to total and permanent disability lasts for the duration of the disability.

facts.name: Premium Waiver Duration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum period for which premiums can be waived is 24 consecutive months.

facts.sentence: This policy begins accumulating guaranteed cash value in Policy Year 3.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If the Insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date, the Company's liability is limited to a return of premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Without Interest
facts.sentence: If the Insured dies by suicide within 24 months of the Policy Date, the Company’s liability does not include interest on returned premiums.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: Suicide exclusion applies regardless of whether the Insured was sane or insane at the time of death.

facts.sentence: Material misrepresentation in the application allows the Company to contest the policy within 24 months of the Policy Date.

facts.sentence: After 24 months from the Policy Date, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Non-Payment Exception
facts.sentence: The only exception to incontestability after 24 months is non-payment of premium.

facts.sentence: No exclusions apply for war-related deaths under the policy.

facts.name: Aviation Death Coverage
facts.sentence: No exclusions apply for aviation-related deaths under the policy.

facts.name: Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No exclusions apply for foreign travel-related deaths under the policy.

facts.sentence: Nonforfeiture options become available after the policy accumulates cash value.

facts.sentence: Cash value first becomes available in Year 3 or later of the policy.

facts.sentence: If the Owner stops paying premiums after the policy has cash value, the Owner may choose among nonforfeiture options.

facts.name: Extended Term Availability
facts.sentence: Option A—Extended Term—is available when the Owner stops paying premiums after the policy has cash value.

facts.name: Extended Term Mechanism
facts.sentence: Under Option A—Extended Term—the net cash value is used as a single premium to purchase term insurance.

facts.name: Extended Term Coverage
facts.sentence: Under Option A—Extended Term—the purchased term insurance covers the full Face Amount.

facts.name: Extended Term Duration
facts.sentence: Under Option A—Extended Term—the term insurance lasts for the longest period possible given the net cash value.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Availability
facts.sentence: Option B—Reduced Paid-Up—is available when the Owner stops paying premiums after the policy has cash value.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Conversion
facts.sentence: Under Option B—Reduced Paid-Up—the policy converts to a fully paid-up whole life policy.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Coverage
facts.sentence: Under Option B—Reduced Paid-Up—the new policy has a reduced face amount compared to the original.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up No Premiums
facts.sentence: Under Option B—Reduced Paid-Up—no further premiums are required.

facts.name: Default Nonforfeiture Choice
facts.sentence: If no election is made regarding nonforfeiture options, Option B—Reduced Paid-Up—applies automatically.

facts.name: Preneed Final Expense Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: Southern Dignity Life Insurance Corporation issued a preneed-compatible final expense policy.

facts.name: PeaceKeeper Gold Plan
facts.sentence: The policy is named 'PeaceKeeper Gold' Plan.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is SDLI-PKG-2024-7741.

facts.name: Issue Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is January 10, 2024.

facts.name: Whole Life Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The product form of the policy is Whole Life — Debit Collection — Non-Par.

facts.name: State of Issue: Mississippi
facts.sentence: The state of issue for the policy is Mississippi.

facts.name: Policy Owner Designation
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Magnolia Funeral Services, LLC.

facts.name: Address of Policy Owner
facts.sentence: Magnolia Funeral Services, LLC is located at 211 Old Highway 49, Yazoo City, MS 39194.

facts.name: Insured Person Identified
facts.sentence: The insured under the policy is Earl James Beaumont.

facts.name: Birth Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: Earl James Beaumont was born on February 22, 1944.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Earl James Beaumont was 79 years old at the time of policy issuance.

facts.name: Male Insured
facts.sentence: Earl James Beaumont is male.

facts.name: Contingent Owner Designation
facts.sentence: Gloria Ann Beaumont is designated as the contingent owner of the policy.

facts.name: Marital Relationship Confirmation
facts.sentence: Gloria Ann Beaumont is married to Earl James Beaumont.

facts.name: Ownership Succession Clause
facts.sentence: If the owner dissolves or assigns the policy in writing to the insured’s estate, Gloria Ann Beaumont becomes the owner and assumes all owner rights.

facts.name: Face Amount: $8,500
facts.sentence: The face amount of the insurance policy is $8,500.

facts.name: Weekly Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The weekly debit premium for the policy is $24.60.

facts.name: Premium Collection via Debit Agent
facts.sentence: The collection method for the premium is home collection by a licensed agent known as the 'Debit Agent'.

facts.name: Premium Collection Schedule
facts.sentence: The Debit Agent collects premiums on or about the first Monday of each week.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $1,279.20.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The assigned beneficiary of the policy is Magnolia Funeral Services, LLC.

facts.name: Benefit Assignment Documentation
facts.sentence: The assignment of the death benefit to Magnolia Funeral Services, LLC is documented in Section 3 titled 'Funeral Service Assignment'.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the policy is Gloria Ann Beaumont.

facts.name: Spousal Designation
facts.sentence: Gloria Ann Beaumont is designated as the spouse of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Gloria Ann Beaumont’s share of the death benefit is 100%.

facts.name: Funding Preneed Funeral Services
facts.sentence: This life insurance policy is intended to fund prearranged funeral and burial services.

facts.name: Policy Ownership
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Magnolia Funeral Services.

facts.name: Preneed Contract Agreement
facts.sentence: The insured person has entered into a separately executed Preneed Funeral Contract with Magnolia Funeral Services.

facts.name: Preneed Contract Details
facts.sentence: The Preneed Funeral Contract specifies the exact funeral goods and services to be provided upon the death of the insured.

facts.name: Funding Mechanism for Preneed Contract
facts.sentence: This life insurance policy functions as the funding mechanism for the Preneed Funeral Contract.

facts.name: Benefit Assignment Necessity
facts.sentence: The assignment of the death benefit to the funeral home is essential to the operational design of this arrangement.

facts.name: Simplified Issue Basis
facts.sentence: This policy was issued on a simplified issue basis.

facts.name: Confirmed Health Status at Issue
facts.sentence: Health status for the policy was confirmed at the time of issuance.

facts.name: No Graded Benefit Period
facts.sentence: There is no graded benefit period under this policy.

facts.name: Immediate Full Payout
facts.sentence: The full face amount of $8,500 is payable from the date of issue.

facts.name: Health Disclosure During Application
facts.sentence: Health questions were answered during the application process.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Acceptance
facts.sentence: Issuance of the policy indicates acceptance of the health representations made in the application.

facts.name: No Graded Benefit Period
facts.sentence: There is no graded benefit period.

facts.name: Health Disclosure at Application
facts.sentence: Health questions were answered at the time of application.

facts.name: Policy Acceptance Based on Health Disclosures
facts.sentence: Issuance of this policy constitutes acceptance of the health representations made in the application.

facts.name: Stable Death Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: The death benefit shall not decrease during the life of this policy as long as premiums are paid when due.

facts.name: Inflation Benefit Option
facts.sentence: If the Insured's preneed funeral contract is updated to reflect increased funeral costs, the Owner may apply to increase the Face Amount in $500 increments up to $12,000 total.

facts.name: Increased Face Amount Requirement
facts.sentence: An increased face amount requires evidence of continued insurability.

facts.name: Underwriting Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: Increased amounts require underwriting approval.

facts.name: Irrevocable Benefit Assignment
facts.sentence: The Insured and Owner have irrevocably assigned the death benefit of this policy to Magnolia Funeral Services, LLC.

facts.name: Assignment Limitation Scope
facts.sentence: The assignment is limited to the extent of the actual cost of contracted funeral goods and services at the time of death.

facts.name: Excess Benefit Payout Rule
facts.sentence: Any death benefit proceeds exceeding the cost of funeral services shall be paid to the Contingent Beneficiary Gloria Ann Beaumont.

facts.name: Excess Proceeds Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Excess proceeds shall be paid within 5 business days of the funeral home's final accounting.

facts.name: Funeral Home Closure Effect
facts.sentence: If the contracted funeral home ceases operations, the assignment becomes void.

facts.name: Beneficiary Transfer on Assignment Void
facts.sentence: If the assignment becomes void due to cessation of operations, the Contingent Beneficiary becomes the sole beneficiary.

facts.name: Right to Transfer Contract
facts.sentence: The Insured retains the right to transfer the preneed contract and assignment to a different licensed funeral home.

facts.name: Transfer Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: A transfer requires 30 days written notice to the Company.

facts.name: Weekly Premium Collection
facts.sentence: Premiums are collected weekly by a licensed De

facts.name: Weekly Premium Collection
facts.sentence: Premiums are collected weekly.

facts.name: Debit Agent Collection
facts.sentence: A licensed Debit Agent collects premiums.

facts.name: Debit Agent Assignment
facts.sentence: The Debit Agent is assigned to the Insured's service area.

facts.name: Advance Payment Option
facts.sentence: If the Insured is unavailable on the scheduled collection date, the Insured may pay up to 4 weeks in advance.

facts.name: Premium Receipt Book Provision
facts.sentence: A premium receipt book is provided for all payments.

facts.name: Grace Period for Missed Payments
facts.sentence: There is a grace period of 28 days from the due date of any missed weekly premium.

facts.name: Policy Continuity During Grace Period
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force during the grace period.

facts.name: Failed Collection Notice Procedure
facts.sentence: If collection cannot be made after 2 consecutive weekly attempts, the Debit Agent will leave a written notice.

facts.name: Alternative Payment Location
facts.sentence: The Insured may pay at the Company's local service office.

facts.name: Convert to Monthly EFT Collection
facts.sentence: The Owner may elect to convert to monthly EFT collection.

facts.name: EFT Conversion Flexibility
facts.sentence: Conversion to monthly EFT collection can occur at any time.

facts.name: No Fee for Monthly EFT Conversion
facts.sentence: No fee applies when converting to monthly EFT collection.

facts.name: Cash Value Accrual Start
facts.sentence: Cash values begin to accrue in Policy Year 2.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 2
facts.sentence: Illustrative guaranteed end-of-year cash value at the end of Year 2 is $380.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5
facts.sentence: Illustrative guaranteed end-of-year cash value at the end of Year 5 is $1,450.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Illustrative guaranteed end-of-year cash value at the end of Year 10 is $3,600.

facts.name: Policy Assignment to Funeral Home
facts.sentence: This policy is assigned to a funeral home.

facts.name: Loan Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: Policy loans require written consent of the assignee.

facts.name: Assignee Identification
facts.sentence: The assignee is Magnolia Funeral Services.

facts.name: Loan Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: Written consent from Magnolia Funeral Services is required for policy loans during the term of the assignment.

facts.name: Mutual Agreement for Cancellation
facts.sentence: Cancellation of the preneed contract and assignment requires mutual written agreement of all parties.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Conditions
facts.sentence: If the preneed contract and assignment are canceled by mutual written agreement of all parties, the Owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Terms
facts.sentence: When surrendered under mutual written agreement, the policy is surrendered for its net cash value.

facts.name: Automatic Nonforfeiture Option
facts.sentence: After Policy Year 2, if premiums lapse, automatic option applies.

facts.name: Automatic Reduced Paid-Up Insurance
facts.sentence: The automatic option provides Reduced Paid-Up whole life insurance.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Face Amount Proportionality
facts.sentence: The face amount of the Reduced Paid-Up whole life insurance is proportional to the cash value.

facts.name: Lapse Survival Assignment
facts.sentence: The assignment to the funeral home remains in effect for the reduced amount after a lapse.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: If the Insured wishes to reinstate the policy, all overdue premiums must be paid.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Interest at 5% per annum must be paid on overdue premiums during reinstatement.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement must occur within 3 years of the lapse.

facts.name: Suicide Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: Suicide death within 24 months of issue triggers a return of only premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Refund Terms
facts.sentence: No interest is paid on refunded premiums due to suicide within 24 months of issue.

facts.name: Contestability Due to Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Material misrepresentation in health questions allows the Company to contest coverage.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: Contestability period lasts up to 24 months from issue date.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Post-24 Months
facts.sentence: After 24 months, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: The exception to incontestability is non-payment of premiums.

facts.name: No War Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy does not exclude war as a cause of death.

facts.name: No Military Service Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy does not exclude military service as a cause of death.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy does not exclude aviation as a passenger as a cause of death.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy does not exclude foreign travel as a cause of death.

facts.name: 30-Day Free Look Period
facts.sentence: There is a 30-day free look period beginning from the delivery date.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Eligibility
facts.sentence: A full refund of premium is available if the policy is returned to the Debit Agent within the free look period.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Eligibility
facts.sentence: A full refund of premium is available if the policy is returned to the Company within the free look period.

facts.name: Change Funeral Home Assignee
facts.sentence: The Insured may request a change of funeral home assignee.

facts.name: Change Funeral Home Assignee Procedure
facts.sentence: The procedure for changing the funeral home assignee is described in Section 3.4.

facts.name: Marital Status Change & Beneficiary Update
facts.sentence: If the Insured's marital status changes, the Contingent Beneficiary designation may need adjustment.

facts.name: Change of Funeral Home Assignee
facts.sentence: The Insured may request a change of funeral home assignee.

facts.name: Change of Funeral Home Assignee
facts.sentence: A change of funeral home assignee is described in Section 3.4.

facts.name: Marital Status Change Update
facts.sentence: If the Insured's marital status changes, the Contingent Beneficiary designation may be updated.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Update Requirement
facts.sentence: An update to the Contingent Beneficiary designation requires written notice.

facts.name: Claim Submission Timing
facts.sentence: Magnolia Funeral Services submits a claim upon completion of funeral services.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Required Claim Documentation
facts.sentence: A signed funeral home claim form is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: An itemized statement of services is required to submit a claim.

facts.name: Excess Proceeds Payable to Gloria Ann Beaumont
facts.sentence: Any excess proceeds from the claim are paid to Gloria Ann Beaumont.

facts.name: Excess Proceeds Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Excess proceeds are paid to Gloria Ann Beaumont within 10 business days of final accounting.

facts.name: Claim Inquiry Contact Method
facts.sentence: Claims inquiries can be made by calling 1-800-SDL-CARE.

facts.name: Claims Inquiry Mailing Address
facts.sentence: Claims inquiries can be sent via mail to P.O. Box 204, Jackson, MS 39205.

facts.name: Company Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Southern Dignity Life Insurance Corporation is located at 400 Capitol Street, Suite 900, Jackson, Mississippi 39201.

facts.name: Toll-Free Contact Number
facts.sentence: Southern Dignity Life Insurance Corporation’s toll-free number is 1-800-735-2273.

facts.name: Signature Authority Confirmation
facts.sentence: The signature on the document is that of the Executive Vice President, Policy Administration.

facts.name: Signing Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The date of signing is January 10, 2024.

facts.name: License Number Verification
facts.sentence: The Mississippi Department of Insurance license number for Southern Dignity Life Insurance Corporation is MS-L-8847201.

facts.sentence: Issuance of the policy is based on satisfactory responses to health screening questions.

facts.name: Lump Sum Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose to receive the death benefit as a lump sum.

facts.name: Default Death Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: The default option for death benefit distribution is a lump sum.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payment Options

facts.name: Minimum Interest Rate for Held Funds
facts.sentence: The minimum annual interest rate for held funds is 3.0%.

facts.name: Withdrawal Rights During Interest Holding
facts.sentence: Beneficiaries retain withdrawal rights while the death benefit is being held at interest.

facts.name: Dividend Payout Options
facts.sentence: The policy offers three payout options: lump sum, 12 equal monthly installments, or holding funds at interest.

facts.name: Minimum Interest Rate on Held Funds
facts.sentence: Interest on held funds must be at least 3.0% annually.

facts.name: Interest-Held Funds Duration
facts.sentence: Funds held at interest can remain invested for up to 5 years.

facts.name: Withdrawal Rights During Interest Hold Period
facts.sentence: Beneficiaries retain the right to withdraw funds held at interest during the 5-year period.

facts.name: Divisible Surplus Eligibility
facts.sentence: This policy is eligible to participate in the Society's divisible surplus.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends under this policy are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Annual Dividend Declaration
facts.sentence: The Board of Trustees declares dividends annually.

facts.sentence: Dividend declarations are based on the Society's actual mortality experience.

facts.name: Dividend Basis: Investment Experience
facts.sentence: Dividend declarations are based on the Society's actual investment experience.

facts.name: Dividend Basis: Expense Experience
facts.sentence: Dividend declarations are based on the Society's actual expense experience.

facts.sentence: Actual dividend amounts may be lower than the illustration.

facts.sentence: Option 1 – Paid-Up Additions is the default dividend option.

facts.sentence: Additional paid-up whole life insurance increases the death benefit over time.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Increase Cash Value
facts.sentence: Additional paid-up whole life insurance increases the cash value over time.

facts.name: Premium Reduction Option
facts.sentence: Option 2 – Premium Reduction allows dividends to reduce the next premium due.

facts.name: Cash Payment Dividend Option
facts.sentence: Option 3 – Cash Payment provides dividends in cash to the owner annually.

facts.name: Accumulate at Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Option 4 – Accumulate at Interest holds dividends at a rate not less than 3.5% per annum.

facts.name: Dividend Withdrawal Flexibility
facts.sentence: Dividends held under Option 4 are withdrawable at any time.

facts.name: Dividend Option Change Frequency
facts.sentence: The owner may change the dividend option once per year.

facts.sentence: Policy loans do not require repayment.

facts.sentence: Outstanding policy loans reduce the death benefit dollar-for-dollar.

facts.sentence: The company will automatically make a policy loan to cover the unpaid premium if criteria are met.

facts.sentence: The owner may decline Automatic Premium Loan in writing.

facts.sentence: Rider face amount is five thousand dollars.

facts.sentence: Rider term duration is ten years.

facts.sentence: Spouse Term Rider expires on June 1, 2034.

facts.sentence: A rider can be added to a new permanent policy without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Rider Termination on Lapse
facts.sentence: The rider terminates if the base policy lapses.

facts.sentence: The rider terminates upon written notice if the spouse and insured divorce.

facts.name: Rider Termination Upon Spousal Death

facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 2 years of the policy date, the death benefit is limited to the return of premiums paid to the society.

facts.sentence: The society may contest the policy on grounds of material misrepresentation within 2 years of the policy date.

facts.sentence: There are no exclusions for travel outside the United States in the policy.

facts.sentence: The duration of coverage under extended term insurance is determined by the nonforfeiture table.

facts.sentence: If the Insured remains tobacco-free for 24 consecutive months after policy issue, the Owner may apply for reclassification to Non-Tobacco rates.

facts.sentence: After reclassification, riders remain unchanged.

facts.name: Tobacco Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: If the Insured declared Non-Tobacco status in the application but actually used tobacco, the death benefit will be adjusted.

facts.name: Tobacco Misrepresentation Penalty
facts.sentence: The reduction in the death benefit applies only when the Insured misrepresented their tobacco use.

facts.name: Tobacco Misrepresentation Adjustment
facts.sentence: The adjusted death benefit equals the amount that would have been purchased at Tobacco rates.

facts.name: Tobacco Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: The same premium rate is applied in determining the adjusted benefit amount.

facts.name: Tobacco Misstatement Adjustment Window
facts.sentence: This adjustment can be made at any time during the contestability period.

facts.name: Additional $20K Accidental Death Payout
facts.sentence: An Accidental Death Benefit Rider (ADB-22) provides an additional $20,000 payout.

facts.name: Additional Accident Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The Additional $20,000 payment occurs if the Insured’s death is caused directly and exclusively by accidental bodily injury.

facts.name: Accidental Death Payout Total
facts.sentence: Total payout including both base and rider coverage is $40,000 in case of qualifying accidental death.

facts.name: Accidental Death Definition
facts.sentence: Accidental death must result from a sudden, unforeseen, external event.

facts.name: 120-Day Injury-to-Death Window
facts.sentence: Death resulting from accidental bodily injury must occur within 120 days of the injury.

facts.name: Accidental Death Exclusion Criteria
facts.sentence: Sickness, disease, or infection cannot contribute to the death for the rider to apply.

facts.name: Accidental Wound Infection Exception
facts.sentence: Exception to exclusion: Infection of an accidental wound is allowed as a contributing factor.

facts.name: Self-Injury Exclusion
facts.sentence: The ADB rider does not pay the additional benefit if death results from self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: ADB Exclusion: DUI
facts.sentence: The ADB rider does not pay the additional benefit if death results from driving under the influence of alcohol with BAC ≥ 0.08%.

facts.name: Felony Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: The ADB rider does not pay the additional benefit if death results from commission of a felony.

facts.name: Riot Participation Exclusion
facts.sentence: The ADB rider does not pay the additional benefit if death results from participation in a riot.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion in ADB Rider
facts.sentence: The ADB rider does not pay the additional benefit if death results from aviation activities.

facts.name: Aviation Passenger Coverage Exception
facts.sentence: Aviation exception: The rider covers deaths occurring while acting as a fare-paying passenger on a commercial flight.

facts.name: BAC Threshold for DUI
facts.sentence: Driving under the influence of alcohol is defined as having a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) greater than or equal to 0.08%.

facts.name: Felony Disqualification
facts.sentence: Commission of a felony results in disqualification from coverage.

facts.name: Riot Participation Exclusion
facts.sentence: Participation in a riot results in disqualification from coverage.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: Aviation participation leads to disqualification unless the individual is a fare-paying passenger on a scheduled commercial airline.

facts.name: ADB Rider Termination at Age 85
facts.sentence: The ADB rider terminates on the Policy Anniversary occurring after the Insured reaches 85 years of age.

facts.name: Base coverage continuity post-rider termination
facts.sentence: Base policy coverage continues beyond the termination of the ADB rider.

facts.name: ADB Rider Removal Right
facts.sentence: The Owner may remove the ADB rider at any time.

facts.name: ADB Rider Removal Impact
facts.sentence: Removing the ADB rider reduces the monthly premium proportionally.

facts.name: Guaranteed Lifetime Premium
facts.sentence: The base premium is guaranteed to remain at $221.40 per month for life.

facts.name: Grace Period for Payments
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days is provided for premium payments.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity

facts.name: Quarterly Payment Amount
facts.sentence: Quarterly premium payments total $703.44 when paid quarterly.

facts.name: Quarterly Payment Discount
facts.sentence: A 2% mode discount applies to quarterly premium payments.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: Annual premium payments total $2,769.60 when paid annually.

facts.name: Annual Payment Discount
facts.sentence: A 4% mode discount applies to annual premium payments.

facts.name: Guaranteed Level Premiums
facts.sentence: Premiums are guaranteed not to increase over time.

facts.name: Guaranteed Level Premiums
facts.sentence: Premiums are guaranteed not to increase even if the Insured’s health deteriorates.

facts.name: Tobacco Use & Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: Premiums are guaranteed not to increase even if the Insured continues using tobacco.

facts.name: Cash Value Accrual Start
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash values begin accruing after Policy Year 1.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 5

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loans are available at an annual interest rate of 7.0%.

facts.name: Loan Limit Based on Cash Value
facts.sentence: Loan amounts can reach up to 90% of the net cash value.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Rider Benefit
facts.sentence: Outstanding loan balances do not affect the ADB rider benefit.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The annual interest rate for available loans is 7.0%.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: Loan amounts can reach up to 90% of the net cash value.

facts.name: ADB Rider Loan Protection

facts.name: Loan Impact on Base Benefit

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Calculation
facts.sentence: Cash surrender value equals gross cash value minus outstanding loans.

facts.name: No Surrender Charges After Year 3

facts.name: Year 2 Surrender Charge

facts.name: Year 3 Surrender Charge
facts.sentence: Surrender charge for Year 3 is 5%.

facts.name: Premium Lapse Settlement Options
facts.sentence: If premiums lapse after cash value exists, the owner must elect one of three options: Reduced Paid-Up whole life, Extended Term, or Cash Surrender.

facts.name: ADB Rider Termination on Lapse
facts.sentence: Reduced Paid-Up whole life results in termination of the ADB rider upon lapse.

facts.name: Extended Term Rider Termination
facts.sentence: Extended Term preserves the face amount but terminates the ADB rider upon lapse.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Termination
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender causes the policy and all riders to terminate.

facts.name: Default Nonforfeiture Option
facts.sentence: The default option when no election is made is Reduced Paid-Up whole life.

facts.name: Suicide Within 24 Months
facts.sentence: Death due to suicide within 24 months of issue results in return of premiums only.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be contested for material misrepresentation during the first 36 months after issue.

facts.name: Extended Contestability Due to Simplified Underwriting
facts.sentence: Contestability applies because the policy was issued at simplified-issue underwriting with health screening.

facts.name: No Full Underwriting
facts.sentence: Full underwriting did not occur for this policy.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 36 Months

facts.sentence: The extended contestability period reflects the use of simplified underwriting.

facts.name: Extended Contestability Period

facts.name: Extended Contestability Period

facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for military service in the policy.
